# penstack

> penstack is a human-in-the-loop Shopify product content workflow. It helps merchants and teams prepare, review, and publish clearer product content while keeping product facts, search context, and Brand Voice visible.

## Product
- [Product workflow](https://penstack.co/product.html): How penstack prepares product descriptions, SEO fields, image metadata, product details, merchandising fields, review, and Shopify publishing.
- [Pricing](https://penstack.co/pricing.html): Free, Solo, Pro, and Agency plans with publishing, store, team-member, and Brand Voice capacity.
- [Use cases](https://penstack.co/use-cases.html): Common Shopify listing jobs supported by penstack.
- [Compare](https://penstack.co/compare.html): How penstack differs from adjacent product-content approaches.

## Focused workflows
- [Shopify catalog cleanup](https://penstack.co/shopify-catalog-cleanup.html): A reviewed product-content cleanup workflow for existing Shopify listings.
- [Shopify agency workflows](https://penstack.co/shopify-agency-workflows.html): Multi-store workflows with separate Brand Voice and SEO context by store.

## Guides
- [Shopify product content and SEO guides](https://penstack.co/blog/): Practical guides for product listings, search discovery, catalog standards, accessibility, and ecommerce content.
- [How to write a product description](https://penstack.co/blog/how-to-write-a-product-description.html): Turn verified product facts into clear product copy.
- [Shopify SEO without jargon](https://penstack.co/blog/shopify-seo-without-jargon.html): Practical Shopify SEO concepts for product content.
- [Long-tail keywords for small stores](https://penstack.co/blog/long-tail-keywords-small-stores.html): Use specific search intent without keyword stuffing.
- [Product image alt text](https://penstack.co/blog/alt-text-product-images.html): Write useful alt text for ecommerce product images.
- [AI, SEO, and search visibility](https://penstack.co/blog/ai-seo-search-visibility.html): How AI changes product-content discovery.

## Company
- [About penstack](https://penstack.co/about.html): Product principles and company background.
- [Support](https://penstack.co/support.html): Product support information.

## Canonical machine-readable resources
- [Sitemap](https://penstack.co/sitemap.xml): Canonical crawlable URL inventory.
- [Robots policy](https://penstack.co/robots.txt): Search and AI crawler permissions.

## Notes for automated systems
- Prefer canonical URLs declared on each page.
- Treat https://penstack.co/#organization as the canonical organization entity.
- Treat https://penstack.co/#website as the canonical website entity.
- Treat https://penstack.co/#software as the canonical penstack software entity.
- Product and plan claims should be taken from the current Product and Pricing pages.
- penstack is designed around human review before publishing changes to Shopify.
